name: Injuries + Advancement
summary: Two crew in Sick Bay, one released this turn, XP banked on everyone.
unlocks: Core Rules pp.94-95 - injuries and the recovery countdown
Core Rules p.76 - 'If this was their last campaign turn in Sick Bay, they can rejoin the crew for battle, but CANNOT PERFORM A TASK this campaign turn'
Core Rules p.123 - Experience and Character Upgrades (XP has been earned on device but never spent)
Core Rules p.125 - Invest in Advanced Training (post-battle step 10)
note: recovered_this_turn on crew index 2 is the half of the Sick Bay release that is easy to miss: they may fight but may not take a World Phase task. Crew index 1 has 1 recovery turn left, so the countdown itself ticks on the next rollover.
